clips.name: coldopen
clips.prompt: Rain streaks run down a window glass in the foreground, a sudden lightning flash illuminates the Bogotá skyline and the Andes mountains behind, then dims back to moody night; neon reflections shimmer in the drops. Slow cinematic push-in.

clips.name: panel-01
clips.prompt: The yellow taxi drifts sideways through the wet street, sheets of rain spray flying off its tires, headlights glowing, reflections streaking on the asphalt; the camera tracks slightly alongside with dynamic energy.

clips.name: panel-04
clips.prompt: Police lights flash blue and red in a chase at night, the green police car speeds forward through rain spray, light reflections pulsing on the wet road, city lights twinkling behind; subtle camera shake.

clips.name: panel-07
clips.prompt: The tall skyscraper tower LED facade cycles through rainbow colors, glowing reflections shifting on the wet plaza pavement, light rain falling, slow upward camera tilt, street lamps glowing.

clips.name: makingof
clips.prompt: Little robots busily building a city on a laptop, bright welding sparks flying, glowing lights flickering, slow cinematic orbit camera around the scene.

clips.name: title-loop
clips.prompt: Subtle living cover art: gentle rain falling, car headlights glinting and flickering on the wet street, neon signs softly pulsing, mist drifting over the mountains, very slow cinematic push-in camera. Calm ambient motion, nothing sudden.

clips.name: panel-06
clips.prompt: Golden hour timelapse over Monserrate: storm clouds roll and drift across the mountain sky, golden sunset light moving across the church and hillside, city lights slowly switching on in the valley below; slow gentle camera push.

clips.name: endcard
clips.prompt: Slow aerial drift over the night panorama of Bogotá, thousands of city lights twinkling, clouds slowly moving over the mountains, gentle parallax; the upper center of the frame stays calm and empty.

clips.name: panel-02
clips.prompt: The red TransMilenio articulated bus glides forward arriving at the station, headlights glowing, rain falling, passengers with umbrellas waiting under the glass shelter, reflections shimmering on the wet road; slow camera dolly.
